properties.description: 12 tests in three files, written before the code. crates/reflow2-core/tests/built_work_reads_as_built.rs (5): a Component whose allocated capabilities are all realized or verified reads `built` and its stored status is unchanged; one with no built evidence (planned or in-progress capabilities, a planned file, a failing check) reads `not_built`; one with some function unbuilt, or a file while a hosted capability is unbuilt, reads `partly_built`, and a part with only a passing check of its own reads `built`; a capability an accepted Decision withdrew is not counted; and understated_status names exactly the planned components whose reading is not `not_built`. crates/reflow2-core/tests/awaiting_the_owners_word.rs (4): a delivered proposed requirement is listed with the capability that delivers it and the call that closes it; a proposed idea whose promotion landed is listed with what it became, and the listed ideas are exactly the ones decision_overtaken_by_promotion reports; an accepted requirement, an accepted idea, an undelivered requirement and an idea whose target has not landed are not listed; loop_status lists them for a named contributor, says so in `next`, keeps `clean`, leaves the unscoped list empty, and moves no status. crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/built_work_reads_as_built_on_the_wire.rs (3): get_node and scan_nodes (brief and full) carry `built_reading` on every Component and on no other type, beside an untouched status, with every key they carried before; loop_status carries `awaiting_word` scoped and `[]` unscoped. The ship-step instruction is pinned separately by tools/skill_lint.py's ship-step contract.
properties.findings: 2026-10-13. Written first (7f0f2086c). Copied onto main ea6329305 in a clean worktree, the 9 core tests did not compile: 16 errors, all for the missing surface (component_build, BuildState, awaiting_word, LoopStatus.awaiting_word). The 3 MCP tests were run with the core change but without the query.rs change: 2 FAILED, because get_node and scan_nodes served no built_reading (left: Null, right: "built"). The skill_lint ship-step contract failed 16 checks (4 files x 4 phrases). With the code (34f767c44, f9598298b), 12 of 12 pass and skill_lint is clean. The whole core suite passes, 2097 tests, 0 failed (cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features). The workspace run passed 3303 tests with 1 failed: derived_relations_are_served still expected 22 relations counted. That one expectation was moved with the new relation in f9598298b, and its 3 tests pass. clippy is clean in both configurations, as is fmt, and the binary-driven Python gates pass. Measured on main's design copy with release builds: built_reading reads 61 built, 28 partly built and 20 not built of 109 components. The 87 planned components with evidence are exactly understated_status's set, and the stored statuses are unchanged. awaiting_word holds 51: 38 delivered requirements and 13 promoted ideas. detect_gaps is unchanged (222).
